what.text: This page follows refugees from Rwanda in all host countries combined.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 244415 Rwandan refugees, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo hosts the largest share, 81.1%.
Uganda is the next largest host.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Rwanda with the FPR from 1990 to 1994, at war level in 1990 and 1994.
From 1996 to 2025 it records later periods of conflict with groups including the ALiR and the FDLR-FOCA.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 1994 and 1995.
UNHCR's figure peaked at 2257570 in 1994 and fell to 63792 by 2004.
Returns to Rwanda were highest in 1996 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees; asylum seekers from Rwanda are counted in a separate series.
Since 2018 the figure has changed very slowly.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
